description: Recommendation letter writer — Write a specific, credible recommendation letter from your notes (name, notes; optional relationship, target program/job, author, tone). Uses only your facts, then checks it offline: numbers not in your notes, generic cliches (team player, hard worker), doubt-raising words (however, adequate), missing standout claim, placeholders and length, with a 0-100 score and STRONG/GOOD/NEEDS_WORK verdict. Price: $0.008 USDC (Base, via x402).

notes.description: e.g. led the 2025 data migration, cut report time 40%, mentored 3 analysts

name: ai_recommendation_letter
